nameEn: Manufacture of fertilizers and nitrogen compounds
description: This class includes the manufacture of fertilizers and nitrogen compounds.
includes: manufacture of compound fertilizers: NPK fertilizers
manufacture of crude natural phosphates and crude natural potassium salts
manufacture of nitric acid, sulphonitric acids, ammonia, ammonium chloride, ammonium carbonate
excludes: mining of natural phosphates and potassium salts, see 0891
